generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years

The contractor must possess an experience certificate issued by an officer at the district level at least of the rank of Deputy Conservator of Forests certifying that they have successfully executed and completed similar works for the Forest Department or other government department
Line of credit including E-tender Indent No & addressed to ACF DHARWAD/DCF DHARWAD not less then 30% of the Tender amount received from any Nationalized Bank
A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours along with copy of Registration in Labour Department,
EPF details along with copy of EPF Registration Certificate
ESI details along with copy of ESI Registration Certificate
Contractor should be registered in public works department as class-1 and such registration should be valid up to 2026-27
Address proof any only copy of Adhar, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be upladed)
